arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='/workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py'
lines=open(path).read().split('\n')
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.strip() == 'def main():' and l.startswith('    def main():'):
        lines[i] = 'def main():'
        break
open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(lines))
EOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py 0 2>&1 | tail -2 && for seed in 1 2 3; do python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py $seed 2>&1|tail -1; done
